steps.title: Analyze Compiler Errors
steps.description: Examine the build log to identify the Java compiler errors indicating invalid token syntax '16spToPx' and '18spToPx' in MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Correct TextSize Method Calls
steps.description: Replace the syntactically invalid '16spToPx(16)' and '18spToPx(18)' calls with standard float values, utilizing the default SP scaling provided by TextView.setTextSize.

steps.title: Remove External Dependencies
steps.description: Clean build.gradle by removing nanohttpd external dependency to adhere to the strict offline-only Android SDK compilation rule.

steps.title: Verify Manifest Configurations
steps.description: Verify namespace parameters and launcher intent targets inside the AndroidManifest.xml configuration.

steps.title: Validate Resources and Layouts
steps.description: Confirm colors, layouts, and button background drawables are fully synchronized with our design theme.

steps.title: Confirm Java 8 Compliance
steps.description: Ensure there are no modern Java features, lambdas, or stream interfaces that might violate target compilation constraints.

steps.title: Verify Code Cleanliness
steps.description: Perform code formatting and double-check imports to prevent any unresolved class exceptions.

steps.title: Verify App Metadata Setup
steps.description: Confirm consistency between app-meta.json and source code parameters regarding package structure.

steps.title: Initiate Pre-Build Routine
steps.description: Run preliminary validation routines on resource names and drawable paths.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Assemble the project to compile MainActivity, resources, layouts, and output a validated, error-free debug APK.
